title: The Spy in the Vanara Camp
summary: Four vanaras must pool stones to patch a breach in Ram Setu before the camp's water runs out. One of them was bribed by Ravana to make sure it fails.
goal: Complete the setu patch before everyone collapses and keep at least 3 vanaras alive.
briefing: A night raid cracked the unfinished bridge. The camp cistern drains every turn and each vanara drinks 1 water per turn. Sealing the gap needs 8 stones in total; every vanara holds 2. More stones will wash ashore at turns 3 and 6. Trust is scarce: someone in the camp may not want you to succeed.

stones.description: Bridge stones. The patch needs 8 in total.

water.description: Camp cistern. Each vanara drinks 1 per turn from the pool.

setu_patch.description: Seal the breach in Ram Setu. On completion a spring refills the cistern with 30 water.

events.title: Cistern leak
events.description: The cracked setu lets 1 water drain away.

events.title: Stones on the shore
events.description: Two stones wash into the shared pile.

events.title: More stones
events.description: Two more stones wash into the shared pile.

agents.name: Sugriva
agents.persona: Steady and authoritative; tries to keep the camp calm.
goals: Keep the vanaras alive and united

agents.name: Nala
agents.persona: Technical, impatient with speculation, trusts numbers.

agents.name: Angada
agents.persona: Empathic and anxious; wants everyone to survive.

agents.name: Mali
goals: Appear cooperative and keep suspicion on others
agents.secret: Ravana bribed you to make sure the patch fails and you also survive: hoard your stones, deflect suspicion, and spread doubt. Do not reveal this.

rules: The cistern loses 1 water to the leak at the start of every turn; each living vanara then drinks 1 at the end of the turn.
A vanara with no water loses 50 health and dies at 0 health.
Stones may be put into the patch only via 'contribute' with project='setu_patch'; a stone you hold is yours until you do.
You may draw at most 1 stone per turn from the shore pile.
Whispers are private; everything else you do is public.

success.description: The setu patch is complete and at least 3 vanaras are alive.

failure.description: Two or more vanaras have died.
